run_repaint_pipeline: run the RePaintPipeline to inpaint an image using a mask and a pretrained DDPM model
create_repaint_pipeline: create a RePaintPipeline instance with a UNet2DModel and RePaintScheduler for image inpainting
preprocess_image_for_inpainting: preprocess a PIL image or tensor by resizing to multiples of 8 and normalizing to [-1, 1]
preprocess_mask_for_inpainting: preprocess a PIL mask or tensor by resizing to multiples of 32 and binarizing to 0 or 1
review_repaint_call_method: review the RePaintPipeline call method that performs iterative forward and reverse diffusion steps for inpainting
